errors.fileAccessDenied: You do not have access to this file
errors.invalidFilePath: Cannot access the original image (invalid file reference). Use Re-upload (top right) to capture and recognize again.

errors.mimoUnavailable: AI recognition is temporarily unavailable (MiMo API error). Wait 1–2 minutes and try again; contact your admin if it persists
errors.aiPromptNotFound: Recognition prompt not found. Check base-config/prompts.md
errors.aiContinuePromptNotFound: Continue prompt not found. Check base-config/prompts.md
errors.aiHeaderEcho: The model returned column headers (e.g. name/supplier) as data instead of real rows. Check the working country and upload a clearer photo
errors.aiInvalidJson: The model returned JSON lines that could not be parsed. Try a clearer image.
errors.aiNoParseableRecords: The model did not return parsable attendance JSON rows. Try a clearer image.
errors.aiFabricated: Results contain multiple prompt example rows, not real sheet data. Upload a clearer, complete attendance sheet
errors.aiMalformedRecords: {malformedPercent}% of recognized rows have invalid structure ({malformedCount}/{recordCount} rows), above the {thresholdPercent}% threshold. Upload a clearer, complete attendance photo.
errors.aiUnreadableTimes: Many names/IDs are unreadable but times look filled in uniformly — likely guessed. Upload a clearer photo
errors.aiImageTooBlurry: The photo is not clear enough to read the attendance sheet reliably. Retake it straight-on with good lighting, or upload a sharper image.
errors.aiImageTooBlurryBlurRows: The photo is not clear enough: about {blurPercent}% of attendance rows are hard to read (blurry handwriting or unclear names/IDs). Retake straight-on with good light and avoid camera shake.
errors.aiImageTooBlurryUnknownFields: About {unknownPercent}% of key fields (employee ID, name, arrival/departure times, etc.) could not be read. Please upload a sharper photo and try again.
errors.aiImageTooBlurryFewRows: Very few attendance rows were recognized, and many fields are unreadable. Make sure the full sheet is in frame and in focus, then retake the photo.
errors.uploadImageTooBlurry: The image is too blurry to upload. Please retake the photo (straight-on, good light, no motion blur).
errors.imageQualityBlockReasonBlurRows: Low-readability row ratio exceeded block threshold
errors.imageQualityBlockReasonUnknownFields: Critical-field unknown rate exceeded block threshold
errors.imageQualityBlockReasonFewRowsUnknown: Too few effective rows with high unknown rate
errors.systemError: System error, please try again later
errors.networkError: Network error, please check your connection
errors.imageQualityStatsRangeNamedRows: Rows with name or employee ID
